name: toggl-client
description: API Client for the Toggl API

scripts.test: npm run build && concurrently -k -s first -n track,reports,vitest "npm:mock:track" "npm:mock:reports" "node scripts/wait-ports.js 4010 4011 && npm run test:unit"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node -e "process.env.TOGGL_E2E='true'; import('vitest/node').then(m => m.startVitest('test', ['run']))"
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && node -e "process.env.TOGGL_E2E='true'; import('vitest/node').then(m => m.startVitest('test', ['run', 'test/smoke-test.ts']))"
